purpose: supersede the comparability RULE applied to the Stage-3 evaluation protocol, without altering the protocol, the thresholds, or any historical artifact

material.image: the real container image digest when the host exposes one; otherwise the image ref/tag alone
material.generation: every field the protocol already declares except ['runtime_digest', 'evaluation_protocol_hash', 'generation_protocol_fingerprint']
material.also: scoring contract + digest, and battery identity

rule.supersedes: exact equality over the fused imageName@driver field, which made comparability a host lottery

historical_artifacts_unmodified.note: read and hashed here, never written. These hashes are the evidence that the migration changed nothing historical.

result.sole_formerly_material_difference: the exact NVIDIA driver patch, reached through runtime_digest -> runtime.image_digest, whose suffix is the host driver version rather than a container image digest

what_this_does_not_claim: that NVIDIA drivers are universally irrelevant to generation
that a driver BRANCH change is inert -- it still fails closed
that the Stage-3 thresholds, pooled_counts@v2, the search, the recovery design, the seeds or the science plan change in any way
phase_a_stage0_requirement: BOTH: the thresholds artifact still declares the untouched 250f72efbd43b86a475e8dda293b45f07ee61a4d858e147f4a5bd7681c32c2e4, AND the live protocol is comparable to that historical protocol under generation_runtime_comparability@v2
